source: Official PSN trophy list, read via Exophase on 20 November 2026

trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game and the platinum follows automatically - there is no extra task hiding behind it. Work the story first, clear the character strands before the finale, then use this tracker to close out the grinds; A Long Road (100% completion) is usually the last one standing.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Gone Fishing'. It arrives as part of the early campaign, so simply playing the missions in order unlocks it - no preparation or side condition is involved.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete every mission the game files under Chapter 1. Pure campaign progress: follow the story markers and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the campaign. As with every chapter trophy, it is earned by finishing the chapter's missions in order and cannot be skipped on the way through the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the campaign. By now the map and most systems are open, so it is a good moment to start the collectible and activity grinds alongside the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the campaign. Treat the end of this chapter as your warning bell: the finale is close, so finish the character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) before pushing on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Before you start it, finish the five character strands and keep a manual save from just before the point of no return - that save is your insurance for the choice-based trophy (Actions Speak Louder) as well.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.watch: Treat the finale as a point of no return: clear every character strand first.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Breakfast Run'. A named campaign mission like the chapter trophies: play the story in order and it unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'The Cartel Heist'. It is a set-piece campaign heist, so it unlocks by playing the story; the skills it teaches feed straight into the free-roam vault robberies of Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Child's Play'. Campaign progress only - complete the mission when the story offers it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Headliners'. Campaign progress only - complete the mission when the story offers it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'VCIA Takedown' - VCIA is Vice City International Airport, which the mission also teaches you to move around; that knowledge pays off later for Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Campaign progress only - complete the mission when the story offers it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion counter. The pause-menu checklist is the route: story, strands, activities, collectibles, discoveries and property all feed the same percentage. Work category by category and let this tracker mirror the list; it is the natural final trophy before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the stunt spots scattered across Leonida - jumps and set-piece leaps, each one-and-done. Sweep them region by region rather than hunting at random, and keep a fast, tough vehicle for the landings; stunt progress also counts toward 100% completion.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Attempt every type of activity once: a race, a stunt, a shooting-range round, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a drone race and so on. The activities list in the menus names the types; a single attempt at each is enough - you do not need to win them for this one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge. Medals are per challenge and only your best run counts, so learn each range's target pattern, raise your accuracy stats first, and replay challenges one at a time rather than running the whole set.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one. Take a practice run to learn each course's gates, then race it clean - clipping every gate in order matters more than raw speed, and one win per location is all you need.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events. Each distinct event counts once, so travel and enter new races instead of re-running a favourite; any vehicle class counts unless the event itself restricts it. This pairs naturally with Top Fun's drone races on the same map sweep.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in one of his fishing challenges. Do not challenge him with the starter tackle: unlock a mid-tier rod and the better lures first, fish the spots his challenge names, and his target weights become comfortably beatable.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish. Cabinets sit in bars and arcades around Vice City; pick the shortest game on the cabinet and finish it once - one completion is all the trophy asks.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand: take every Andy job the map offers, in order, through to his final mission. Strands unlock as the story advances; because this is a strand finale, close it out before starting the story's final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.watch: Strand finale - finish Andy's strand before the story's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission (the name is a wink at Jaws: 'this was no boating accident'). Keep taking Kenton's jobs as they appear and close the strand before the finale.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.watch: Strand finale - finish Kenton's strand before the story's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's jobs appear as the campaign opens up; work them down as they come and close the strand before the finale.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.watch: Strand finale - finish Billy's strand before the story's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers - the chance encounters marked across Leonida. Each strand is a short chain for one stranger, so finish chains rather than starting many: eight completed strands, anywhere in the state, earn the trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission - Randy's strand is the supply-running one the trophy name points at. Close it before the story finale, like the other strands.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.watch: Strand finale - finish Randy's strand before the story's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Take Tyrone's jobs as they unlock and close the strand before the finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.watch: Strand finale - finish Tyrone's strand before the story's final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. The spots are scenic lookouts spread over the whole state; finding them also uncovers the map, so sweep them region by region together with The Goodtime State's exploration.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Bret's hunting strand builds to a named, one-off animal that only appears inside his mission - follow his markers, bring a scoped rifle, and do not expect to find the animal in free roam.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden pickups grouped into themed sets; hunt set by set and use the collection screen to see exactly which cards a set still needs instead of wandering the whole map.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations - the game's marked photo and social spots: viewpoints, murals and landmarks. Snap one whenever you pass a marker and the hundred arrives long before the map is finished.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges - the small timed and skill tasks listed in the activities and challenges menus. Story and open-world play complete many of them without trying; check the list late in the game and mop up the short ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you - the other protagonist in free roam - climb to a 4-star wanted level, then lose the stars and fully escape the search together. Raise the heat somewhere open, break line of sight as a pair, and stay hidden until the search ends; both characters must come through it.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping a wanted level alive the whole time. Plan a route of three nearby stores first: rob, move fast, rob again - if the stars blink out between shops, the chain resets and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.watch: The wanted level must never fully clear between the three robberies.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles - a model logs the first time you take its wheel. Airport and marina car parks, rich districts and dealerships give the fastest variety; work it alongside showroom trophy Capital Offense.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one Combat Focus activation. Set it up before you trigger: a gang hideout or a tight group of enemies, everyone in view, then activate and work the group before the meter drains.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an aircraft at VCIA - Vice City International Airport - and take off without clearance: an unscheduled departure. The story's VCIA Takedown mission teaches the airport's layout; in free roam, a fast plane from the executive ramp gives you the shortest run to the runway and the air.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.watch: Cryptic description - this guide is the plainest reading of the official text.

trophies.guide: The Rhinos are the military's tanks, and it gets hot inside one: get into a Rhino - military convoys and the base are where they live - and stay in it while the heat it draws comes down on you. The trophy is about time spent in the tank under fire, so do not bail at the first stars.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.watch: Cryptic description - this guide is the plainest reading of the official text.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Case the store first, go in quietly, keep the staff calm and get out before any alarm - being spotted even once voids the attempt, so treat it as one clean run and retry the whole robbery if it goes loud.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.watch: One clean run: detection at any point voids the attempt.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one - the escape counts, not just the robbery. Vault jobs appear as heist setups around the state; bring your partner, stage a fast car on a planned route, and repeat at five different vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trucks run set routes; ambush one away from police attention, crack it quickly and lose the heat. One clean truck is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Uncover all of Leonida - every region of the map explored. Driving or flying through a district reveals it; one long coastal loop plus the inland towns and the Keys covers most of the state, and the meditation spots of Positive Mental Attitude sit in the same corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in the state. Every gang runs its own fronts; the map's gang colours tell you whose operation is whose - hit one of each gang's, not the same gang five times.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The name - 'In The Beginning...' - points at the game's opening stretch; if it did not pop during the intro, return to Ocean Beach in free roam and order a cocktail at a beach bar facing the water.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.watch: Cryptic description - this guide is the plainest reading of the official text.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it out through the glass - in classic style. The premium dealerships of Vice City are the obvious targets; pick a car near the window, get in and drive straight out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through - play a bowling game there. The title is a nod to an old friend who always wanted to go bowling; a full game at the alley is the plainest reading of the description.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.watch: Cryptic description - this guide is the plainest reading of the official text.

trophies.guide: A partner trophy with a deliberately cryptic description: 'a partnership with mass appeal'. It sits among the Lucia-and-Jason partner trophies, so work the pair's joint feats first - Hot Together and Retail Therapy - and keep both characters playing together; the guide will be updated as the exact trigger is confirmed by players.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.watch: Cryptic description - this guide is the plainest reading of the official text.

trophies.guide: A story-choice trophy: the description reads 'choices made (for better or worse)'. Keep a manual save before the campaign's big decisions. If a choice locks away the outcome you did not take, that save is what lets you see the other branch without replaying the whole story.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.watch: Choice-based: keep a manual save before big story decisions.

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' - the trophy rewards failing once and succeeding on the retry. When a mission or challenge offers you a retry after a failure, take the retry and finish it; do not reload an earlier save to erase the failure, or there is no second time.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.watch: Do not reload after a first failure - the retry is the trophy.

trophies.guide: An oddity trophy: 'what the hell just happened?' Leonida hides strange encounters - lights in the sky, things moving in the swamp. When something weird starts in free roam, stay and see it through instead of driving on; these trophies pop at the end of the encounter, not the start.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.watch: Cryptic description - this guide is the plainest reading of the official text.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by: strike pedestrians with melee attacks from a moving vehicle - the people are the pins, and 'Ten Pin' is the set to knock down. A slow pass along a crowded pavement, swinging as you go, is the reliable setup.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; instead of spending them raw, run them through your laundering contacts and the counter climbs with every wash. The vault and truck robberies feed it fastest.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops - clothes, weapons, vehicles and services all count toward the same total. It accumulates on its own as you play; a couple of big vehicle purchases finish it quickly if you are chasing it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the map. Garages are the 'for sale' properties, and they double as storage and fast travel, so buy them as your money allows - the last few need heist-level cash, which is why this usually lands late.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you intend to keep, register it in the app there and then; ten registrations - cars, bikes, anything the app accepts - complete the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
